verdict.rationale: The app has its own documented export: a single run's screenshots, actions and saved annotations can be exported as a trace from the Runs view. That covers part of the user's data, but the export is per-run and its file format is never stated. Missing for 10: bulk export of all data (all runs, saved tasks, settings), documented open/standard export formats, and independent or hands-on confirmation that exports are complete and portable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Export the screenshots, actions and saved annotations from Runs → open a run → ⋯ → Export trace for analysis by another agent.
Every run is kept on the phone: replay it step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top.
